chunks: I was in the presence of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), and he began to speak from himself without my having asked him:

'We are the Proof of God, and we are the Door of God, and we are the Tongue of God, and we are the Face of God, and we are the Eye of God among His creation, and we are the Masters of God's Command among His servants.'

key_terms.بَابُ اللَّهِ: Door of God — the Imam as the gateway through which God's grace and knowledge is accessed
key_terms.حُجَّةُ اللَّهِ: Proof of God — the Imam as divine evidence and argument for God's guidance on earth
key_terms.عَيْنُ اللَّهِ: Eye of God — the Imam as the watchful presence of God observing His creation
key_terms.لِسَانُ اللَّهِ: Tongue of God — the Imam as the divinely authorized spokesman for God's will
key_terms.وَجْهُ اللَّهِ: Face of God — the Imam as the manifest presence of the Divine on earth
key_terms.وُلَاةُ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ: Masters of God's Command — the Imams as the authorized administrators of divine authority

ai.seo_question: What are the six titles that Imam al-Baqir declared for the Ahlulbayt?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Aswad ibn Sa'id reports that Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) — the fifth Imam — voluntarily declared six exalted titles of the Ahl al-Bayt: that they are God's Proof (Hujja), Door (Bab), Tongue (Lisan), Face (Wajh), Eye (Ayn) among creation, and Masters of God's Command (Wulat Amr Allah) among His servants. This spontaneous declaration without being questioned signals its doctrinal importance — the Imam wished to ensure this creedal knowledge was recorded and transmitted. In Shia theology, these titles describe the Imams' role as divine intermediaries: they are the channel through which God's guidance, mercy, and authority flow to humanity.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Muhammad Bin Humran, from Aswad Bin Saeed who said, 
‘I was in the presence of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> initiated saying from without having been questioned:

‘We<sup>asws</sup> are the Proof<sup>asws</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the Door of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the tongue of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the Face of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the eye of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> among His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the Masters of the Command of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> among His<sup>azwj</sup> servants’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn abu Nasr from Muhammad ibn Humran from Aswad ibn Sa‘id who has said the following. “I was in the presence of Imam abu Ja‘far (a.s.), who began to speak without any question from me.”

“We are the authority of Allah. We are the door to Allah. We are the tongue of Allah. We are the face of Allah. We are the eyes of Allah in His people. We are the authority in the commandments of Allah among His servants.”
